description:
Remove the `gate-prefix` option of the `criteria-to-check` assertion, so a criterion binds to its check through one mechanism and no rule composes a gate key.

## Background

`criteria-to-check` (`crates/jit/src/declarations/rules.rs:588`) accepts `gate-prefix` and `check-namespace`, with at least one required. `gate-prefix` is documented with `verify:`, which composes keys such as `verify:REQ-01` that fail the lowercase-kebab gate-key grammar. `criterion_is_checked` (`crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:1376`) ORs a `gates_required` membership test with a check label, so the gate branch never required a per-criterion gate to exist or pass. Both rules in `docs/examples/nyquist/rules.toml` already set `check-namespace`, and no issue in this repository holds a prefixed key. The option also appears in `repository_state/rule_serialize.rs`, `validation/desugar.rs:661`, `docs/how-to/validation-rules.md` and rule tests.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `criteria-to-check` has no `gate-prefix` option, in the typed declaration, the evaluator, the rule serializer, desugaring and the published rule schema.
- [hard] REQ-02: `check-namespace` is required and non-optional, the "at least one of" check is gone, and the evaluator's unchecked-criterion message names only the check label.
- [hard] REQ-03: A `rules.toml` naming `gate-prefix` fails to load with a config error naming the rule, and a test shows it.
- [hard] REQ-04: Documentation, examples and tests describe criteria checks through labels only, and no source outside that rejection test spells `gate-prefix` or composes a `verify:` gate key.
title: Criteria checks bind through check labels only
